costume.name: Headless Horseman
costume.description: Raised shoulders and a black cloak hide the head inside a theatrical illusion, with dark trousers and riding-style boots.
costume.alt: Headless illusion costume with a black cape, raised empty collar, white lace ascot, black trousers and tall dark boots.
